text: As of {date}, the heartbeat completed {value} full tick(s) in the last day.
probe: sql:SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM tick_runs WHERE finished_at >= datetime({now}, '-1 day') AND steps_completed = steps_total

text: As of {date}, {value} predictions have been scored against what happened.
probe: sql:SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM predictions WHERE verdict IS NOT NULL

text: As of {date}, {value} specified capabilities are marked BUILT.
As of {date}, {value} specified capabilities are still PLANNED and not built: {names}.
As of {date}, {value} work items are blocked or open as known risks.
probe: sql:SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM items WHERE status = 'blocked'

text: As of {date}, {value} capability packs are enabled: {names}.
probe: sql:SELECT COUNT(*) AS value, COALESCE(group_concat(substr(key, 6), ', '), 'none') AS names FROM org WHERE key LIKE 'pack:%' AND value = 'enabled'

text: The scope file states what is not done by default.
As of {date}, {value} changes were merged and verified.
probe: sql:SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM outcomes WHERE action_class = 'merge' AND result = 'verified'

text: As of {date}, {value} changes failed their merge and were not accepted.
probe: sql:SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM outcomes WHERE action_class = 'merge' AND result IN ('failed', 'hidden_failure')

text: As of {date}, model spend per merged change is {value} US dollars.
probe: sql:SELECT ROUND(SUM(c.cost_usd) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outcomes WHERE action_class = 'merge' AND result = 'verified'), 0), 4) AS value FROM router_calls c

text: As of {date}, {value} percent of the heartbeat ticks in the last 7 days completed every step.
probe: sql:SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN steps_completed = steps_total THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS value FROM tick_runs WHERE started_at >= datetime({now}, '-7 days')

text: As of {date}, {value} things the person has not yet answered are open.
probe: sql:SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM elicit_needs WHERE state IN ('open', 'asked', 'gated')
